system.longDesc: If you have appropriate equipment in hand, like handcuffs or rope, you and your target make opposed Fighting (Grappling) rolls. If you win, they take a –4 Defense penalty while restrained, and can’t do anything other than try to escape with a Strength (Might) or Dexterity (Sabotage) test as a major action (minor in Cinematic games), with TN = 2d6 + (your Fighting (Grappling) score).
